# Measured Value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MeasuredValue`](gmeow-MeasuredValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MeasuredValue>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An alias for [`gmeow:Quantity`](gmeow-Quantity.md) — the measured-value perspective on the same value×unit/frame×determinacy×provenance bundle ([`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) alias precedent). Equivalent to [`gmeow:Quantity`](gmeow-Quantity.md) and [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md). Provided for consumers who prefer the 'measured value' terminology common in metrology and sensor standards.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the metrology-flavoured name for the value×unit/frame×determinacy×provenance bundle — the same construct as [`gmeow:Quantity`](gmeow-Quantity.md) / [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) — when aligning with sensor or metrology standards that say 'measured value'.

### Avoid when

- Avoid modelling it as a separate class from its equivalents ([owl:equivalentClass](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#equivalentClass) — they denote one thing) and avoid it for currency-framed money ([`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md)); pick a single alias per export for consistency.

### How to use

- Type the value [`gmeow:MeasuredValue`](gmeow-MeasuredValue.md), fill [`gmeow:quantityValue`](../properties/gmeow-quantityValue.md) / [`gmeow:quantityUncertainty`](../properties/gmeow-quantityUncertainty.md), name [`gmeow:hasUnit`](../properties/gmeow-hasUnit.md) and [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](../properties/gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md), and link [`gmeow:isResultOf`](../properties/gmeow-isResultOf.md); consumers reading any of the three equivalent names see the same value.

### Examples

- ex:reading22 a [`gmeow:MeasuredValue`](gmeow-MeasuredValue.md); [`gmeow:quantityValue`](../properties/gmeow-quantityValue.md) 22.5; [`gmeow:hasUnit`](../properties/gmeow-hasUnit.md) [qudt:DEG_C.](http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/DEG_C.)
